name: CODE : LOVE COMPOUND
source:
This is a game of youth, love, and bento. On a campus painted with something romantic, Meru, has a fateful encounter with the mysterious senpai from the Disciplinary Committee, Mizuki. A single bento box causes their lives to come cross, waiting for that chemical reaction known as...

[From [url=https://fromis9.itch.io/codelove]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于青春、恋爱与便当的游戏。在染上浪漫色彩的校园里，梅露与风纪委员会那位神秘的前辈瑞希迎来了命运般的邂逅。一盒小小的便当让两人的人生轨迹产生交集，静待那场名为恋爱的化学反应悄然发生……

[摘自[url=https://fromis9.itch.io/codelove]itch.io[/url]]
